title: Declutter Your Zoho CRM Interface With Canvas Builder #Shorts
description:
Stop CRM clutter by using Zoho CRM's Canvas Builder. Follow these quick steps to create role-specific layouts and hide unnecessary fields for your team.

1. Go to Setup › Customization › Canvas
2. Create a new view for your specific team
3. Hide unnecessary fields for a cleaner look

Daily Zoho fixes - follow @GSXAutomation

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation. Zoho is a trademark of Zoho Corporation.

#Shorts #ZohoCRM #Zoho #BusinessAutomation

angle.solution: Use 'Canvas Builder' to create role-specific layouts.
steps: Create a new view for your specific team
